findings.observed: Regular font 'Acorn-Regular' without bold, italic, or case emphasis on 'Contain Pecan Nuts, May Contain Walnuts or'
findings.explanation: Regulation (EU) No 1169/2011 Article 21 requires allergens in the ingredients list to be emphasized through a typeset that clearly distinguishes them from the rest of the ingredients (e.g. bold font). findings.verificationLimitations: Extracted from PDF font flags and typeface naming. Custom vector styling or background shading requires visual review.

rule.text: Allergens must be emphasized through a typeset that clearly distinguishes them from the rest of the ingredients.

findings.title: Small font size (2.47 pt) below 6.0 pt threshold
findings.expected: ≥ 6.0 pt (Company/FDA 21 CFR minimum for packaging legibility)
findings.observed: Detected 2.47 pt text (2,1M2S1I0O0 1B2 | 2,1M1S2I0O0 2B1 | kJ) in ArialUnicodeMS

findings.verificationLimitations: Nominal PDF font point size extracted from font descriptor dict. Physical printed x-height depends on typeface glyph proportions and print plate compensation.

rule.source: FDA 21 CFR 101.9 & Packaging Print Preflight Specification
rule.text: Mandatory consumer packaging text must meet or exceed 6.0 pt minimum.

findings.title: Estimated x-height (0.42 mm) below EU 1169/2011 target (1.2 mm)
findings.expected: x-height ≥ 1.2 mm (Regulation (EU) No 1169/2011, Article 13)
findings.observed: Estimated x-height ~0.42 mm for 2.47 pt text (ArialUnicodeMS)

findings.verificationLimitations: This is an approximate ratio estimate (0.485 of nominal height). It is an advisory screening check, not a certified physical optical measurement.

rule.text: Mandatory particulars must be printed with an x-height of at least 1.2 mm.

atwaterScreen.explanation: Declared calories (166 kcal) diverge significantly from standard 4-4-9 macronutrient calculation (535 kcal). Recommend technical review of digestible carbs, fiber deductions, or Atwater specific factors.
atwaterScreen.limitations: General 4-4-9 factors are a screening heuristic. Food-specific factors (e.g. USDA Handbook 74) or dietary fiber deductions may lawfully alter final label calories.

issues: Declared serving size lacks a unit of measurement (e.g. "g" or household measure).
Calculated serving (480g / 8 servings = 60g) does not equal declared serving value (85).

sugarClaim.explanation: Package displays "NO ADDED SUGAR", but ingredient list includes added sugars: Honey, Coconut Sugar, Crystallized Ginger. Under 21 CFR 101.60(c)(2), a product bearing this claim must not contain added sugars or sugar-containing ingredients unless explicitly qualified.

zeroSugars.explanation: Nutrition panel declares "Incl. 0g Added Sugars", but recipe contains caloric sweeteners (Honey, Coconut Sugar, Crystallized Ginger). Requires technical formulation verification to determine if added sugar contributes < 0.5g per serving (permitting 0g rounding).

veganClaim.explanation: Packaging bears "DIETARY INFORMATION: Suitable for Vegans.", but formulation contains Honey (insect / bee product) and declares 45 mg cholesterol (cholesterol is almost exclusively found in animal products). Honey is excluded under international vegan certification standards (e.g. Vegan Society, ISO 23662). Requires regulatory and brand substantiation.

allergenDisclosure.explanation: Specific tree nuts (almond, almonds, pecan, pecans, walnut, walnuts, coconut) are declared in the ingredient list. Under FALCPA (21 U.S.C. 343(w)), allergen naming in the ingredient list fulfills mandatory disclosure, meaning a separate "Contains:" statement is not legally required. However, the package only provides a precautionary "May Contain" statement without a "Contains:" line. Review recommended to ensure company allergen labeling policy is met.

marketCopy.explanation: Kilojoules (kJ) energy declaration detected. US FDA Nutrition Facts (21 CFR 101.9) requires energy declared exclusively in Calories (kcal); kJ is an EU Regulation 1169/2011 requirement.
"Salt" declared as nutrient line. US 21 CFR 101.9 requires "Sodium" declared in milligrams (mg).
"Cereals Containing Gluten" is standard EU Regulation 1169/2011 Annex II wording. US FALCPA identifies specific grains (Wheat).

rules.title: Source Approval Lifecycle Gate
rules.originalQuotation: The content sheet status must be confirmed as Approved prior to final production release.
rules.reason: Content sheet has status "Draft / In Review". Because source is not final approved copy, discrepancies cannot be confirmed as definitive production errors without brand owner resolution.

rules.title: Source Formulation Copy Concordance
rules.originalQuotation: Artwork copy must match approved content sheet copy across ingredients, percentages, and nutrition values.
rules.reason: Discrepancies detected between content sheet and printed carton: Honey percentage mismatch (9% in sheet vs 1% on carton), plus unapproved carton ingredients (Walnuts, Flax Seeds, Dried Strawberries, Pumpkin Seeds).

rules.title: Statement of Identity Prominence
rules.originalQuotation: Product statement of identity (GRANOLA) must appear prominently on the Front PDP in bold, legible typography.
rules.reason: "GRANOLA" appears on the Front panel as dominant display typography (71.3 pt Acorn-Bold).

rules.title: Net Quantity PDP Placement and Dual Units
rules.originalQuotation: Net quantity must be declared on the Front PDP in both US customary and metric units under 21 CFR 101.7.
rules.reason: Net quantity "480g" on Back panel does not meet US requirements: Missing US customary declaration (ounces / pounds). 15 U.S.C. 1453 and 21 CFR 101.7 require dual declaration in both US Customary and metric units. Net quantity is located on "Back" panel instead of the Principal Display Panel (PDP) as required by 21 CFR 101.7.

rules.originalQuotation: Business name and complete address (city, state, ZIP) must appear on the information panel per 21 CFR 101.5.

rules.title: Nutrition Facts Panel Structural Format

rules.title: Nutrition Arithmetic and Daily Value Accuracy
rules.originalQuotation: All declared %DV values and total calories must align mathematically with stated nutrient amounts under FDA 21 CFR 101.9.
rules.reason: 10 declared % Daily Values conflict with computed FDA 2016 standards (Total Fat, Saturated Fat, Cholesterol, Sodium, Carbs, Fiber, Vit D, Calcium, Iron, Potassium), and calories (166 kcal) diverge from Atwater sum (535 kcal).

rules.title: Tree Nut Allergen Disclosure Standard

rules.reason: Almonds, Pecans, and Walnuts are formulation ingredients, but carton provides only a precautionary "May Contain" statement without a "Contains:" statement.

rules.title: No Added Sugar Claim Substantiation
